releases.title: Smart Poster v1.1.0
releases.summary: Multi-Platform Keyword Radar, 1-click Opportunity Queue launcher, Twitter clean domain rule, and domain/thread suppression lists.

releases.title: Smart Poster v1.0.0
releases.summary: Initial Manifest V3 Universal Side Panel with multi-length directory form filler, contact form automation, and local campaign profiles.

changelog.title: AI Assistant Upgrade: Full Marketing Content Creator
changelog.description: Upgraded the AI Assistant into a versatile content creator and marketing copy generator. Beyond filling SmartPoster modules, use it to brainstorm campaigns, scan reference pages, and craft promotional copy, social threads, emails, and marketing assets for your entire business.

changelog.title: Dedicated Promotional Images Gallery
changelog.description: Save, label, and organize promotional banners, product screenshots, and marketing creatives in a dedicated per-campaign Gallery—synced between the Dashboard and Chrome Extension for instant drag-and-drop onto any webpage.

changelog.title: Comment Favorites (Starring) & Drag-and-Drop Priority Reordering
changelog.description: Star your top-converting comment variations to keep favorites pinned at the top, and drag-and-drop to reorder your comment list by priority with automatic sequential numbering.

changelog.title: Anti-Ban Velocity Tracker & Rolling Hourly Guard
changelog.description: Live per-platform daily counters and rolling 60-minute rate monitoring (SAFE, CAUTION, SLOW DOWN) built directly into the extension to help prevent shadowbans and spam flags during outreach sessions.

changelog.title: Reliable Single-Pass Insertion for X (Twitter) & Modern Rich-Text Editors
changelog.description: Resolved duplicate/undeletable text issues in X/Twitter Draft.js and modern editors (Pinterest, YouTube, Reddit, LinkedIn), and added automatic scroll-and-highlight guidance straight to the native Reply/Post button.

changelog.title: Cross-Device Cloud Sync & Media Asset Vault
changelog.description: Sync your campaigns, uploaded logos/favicons/screenshots, comment images, suppression lists, and posting rules automatically across devices when signed in with Google.

changelog.title: Full-Screen Left-Hand User Dashboard
changelog.description: Edit campaigns, review reports, configure AI settings, browse the Admin-curated Directory Database, download releases, and review release notes in a full-width browser workspace synced directly with your Chrome Side Panel.

changelog.title: Research & Automated Competitor Alerts (Zero API Keys)
changelog.description: Keywords is now Research! Track brand keywords and competitors with automatic high-intent phrases ("Alternative to X", "Best alternative to X"), instant native feed polling, and 1-click Google Alerts RSS capture.

changelog.title: Directory Table Bookmarks & Custom User Directories
changelog.description: Browse all Admin-managed directories in a sortable table, star favorites for quick access, and add your own custom directories.

changelog.title: Twitter / X Clean Domain Formatting Fix
changelog.description: Fixed duplicate URL glitches on X/Twitter replies by automatically formatting links cleanly without protocol prefixes when enabled in Posting Rules.
